_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.BeamColours: A colour of its own for each quest's beam
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.BeamNearest: One beam, to the nearest quest (off: a beam to each quest)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.Compass: Cardinal directions (N, E, S, W) on the rim
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.CutHeight: Cut height in caves and houses
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.CutOutside: Cut away objects over you outdoors too
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.CutUnderground: Cut away objects over you in underground worlds (Blackreach)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DebugColours: Colour the map by source (objects red, land green, water blue, distant LOD yellow)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DebugLog: Detailed log / performance (log file + on-screen panel)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DestinationBeam: Beam to the destination set on the world map
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DetectAll: Everyone but followers only with a detect spell
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DetectEnemies: Enemies only with Detect Life / Aura Whisper
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DetectOnly: Characters only with a detect spell
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DistantLand: Distant land and objects (beyond the loaded area)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.DynamicZoom: Dynamic zoom (closer when slow, farther when sprinting or riding)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.Fog: Fog of war (the map hidden where you have not been)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.FogReset: Reset the fog for this save
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.FogResetConfirm: Click again to forget everything explored
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.Intro: A detailed 3D map built from the world's real meshes: ground, houses, stairs, rocks, furniture.
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.ItemNotFound: Not found - the map stays available
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.LocalMap: Use this map instead of the local map
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.LocalMapHold: Open only while the key is held
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.NeedItem: Map only with an item in the inventory
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.NeedMapMod: Need a map from Helps To Have A Map
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.PointerCamera: Pointer shows where the camera looks (else where you face)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.PressKey: Press a key, combination or gamepad button... (Esc - cancel)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.RangeInside: Minimap range in caves and houses
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.SeeUnderwater: See through the water when diving
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.ShowCleared: Show "Cleared" for cleared places (minimap and local map)
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.ToggleHold: Show only while the key is held
line:menu_translation/detailed-minimap:S.ZoneName: Show the place name by the minimap
